section_title: EIA compliance and HSE in design
text: Every condition of the positive EIA decision (SRC-OWNR-0007) shall be traced to the design measure and evidence in the EIA Conditions Compliance Matrix ALP-EPC-00000-HS-RPT-0001, which shall be updated at each design issue and shall be the record of compliance with ER-14.01; open conditions shall be raised as TQ or design actions.
